turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Hello,

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Hana.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Good to see you. Let me just confirm. Full name and date of birth.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Hana Kobayashi, July 3rd, 1997. Thank you.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Last time you mentioned you were thinking about getting a dog.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Did it happen? It did. A little Shiba puppy. She's chewed two pairs of my shoes already.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: That's the price of admission. So, how has your mood been since July?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Honestly, really steady. On my mood chart, at most days are a 5 or a 6. No big lows, no highs.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: No stretches of feeling revved up, needing less sleep, spending more than usual.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, the last time that happened was two years ago, before we found the right dose. And any low periods,

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: losing interest in things, staying in bed.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, not since last winter, and that was mild.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: How are you sleeping? about seven hours pretty regular I keep the same bedtime like you told me good you're on lamitrigine 200 milligrams once a day correct yes well wait is it 150 no no it's 200 the 150 was before the last increase right 200 any missed doses maybe once a month I forget then I just take it the next day as usual That's fine.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Any rash,

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: mouth sores, or blisters anywhere.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that. Anything else you're taking. Just a multivitamin every morning. Oh, and that's actually what I wanted to ask about. My gynaecologist, Dr.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Alvarez,

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: wants to start me on birth control pills next month. The combination one, norigistimate, and ethanol estradiol. I'm glad you asked.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: That's important. the estrogen in combination pills can lower lamitrogen levels in your blood sometimes by about half so the dose that works now could Stop being enough. Oh, I didn't know that most people don't before we talk plans any thoughts of suicide or of hurting yourself No, none. I still have my safety plan and 988 saved in my phone Good, and I looked at your lab work from your primary care doctor in August your liver and kidney tests were all normal Your blood pressure today is 112 over 70 and your weight is 131 same as last time.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: You're bright and relaxed today,

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: mood euthemic, speech is normal, not pressured, and your thoughts are organized.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: My brother takes lamitrogen for his seizures. Actually, he never mentioned this.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: It applies to anyone on it, so to sum up, your bipolar Roman II disorder is stable on lamitrogen 200 milligrams a day, and we'll keep that dose for now. Here's the plan for the pill. I'd like a baseline lamitrogen level this week, drawn in the morning before your dose at our lab at 2200 Kessler Boulevard, then once you start the pill, we'll recheck the level 2 -3 weeks later, and I'll probably need to increase your dose.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Okay,

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: and if I didn't want to deal with that… A progestin -only option or an IUD wouldn't really affect it, that's worth raising with Dr.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Alvarez,

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: either way is fine with me, just keep me in the loop. I'll talk to her. 2 safety reminders,

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: if you ever get a rash,

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: especially with fever or mouth sores, stop the lamatrogen and call us or go to the emergency room. And if you miss 5 days or more in a row, don't restart at 200 call us because we'd need to build back up slowly.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Got it. Keep the multivitamin,

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: I'll see you in 3 months, unless the level or the pill changes things sooner. Is 317 -555 -0172 still the best number for the lab results? Yep, same number,

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: thanks Dr. Petrenko.
